tasks.short: Survey actual emergency needs for disaster planning.

steps.what: Define emergency-related needs questions, actual population, access constraints and survey method
inputs: actual disaster-planning information gaps
actual affected population and stakeholder context
outputs: chosen actual survey questions, population and method

steps.what: Prepare actual needs survey using chosen questions and native form fields
inputs: chosen actual survey questions, population and method
outputs: complete actual survey draft and recipient/sample route

steps.what: Check final survey wording, accessibility, population coverage, disclosure and actual distribution route
inputs: complete actual survey draft and recipient/sample route
chosen actual survey questions, population and method
outputs: checked final survey and permitted distribution route

steps.what: Distribute exact checked emergency-needs survey through actual permitted route
inputs: checked final survey and permitted distribution route
outputs: actual needs survey distributed

steps.what: Conduct actual surveys or support survey teams and capture actual responses and coverage gaps
inputs: actual needs survey distributed
actual respondent answers and survey-team problems
outputs: actual captured responses, field notes and coverage limitations

steps.what: Summarise actual responses and check final emergency-needs findings and limitations
inputs: actual captured responses, field notes and coverage limitations
actual survey question schema
outputs: checked final actual response summary and needs assessment record

steps.what: Save checked final survey findings and emergency-needs assessment record
inputs: checked final actual response summary and needs assessment record
outputs: saved actual survey findings

tasks.design: Configure native survey fields in the survey module of {OPS_SYSTEM} and response summaries in {BI}. Retain survey design, actual conduct/support and interpretation, checking the final survey before separate distribution and actual findings before separate save.
tasks.previous_blocker: Survey forms and response tallies can be rebuilt manually.
tasks.enabler_now: Native question forms and fixed response summaries can reduce repeated setup and arithmetic.
tasks.still_hard: Coverage, wording and the interpretation of actual emergency needs require field judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The director notices whose needs are missing from the responses.
tasks.altitude: Less survey setup and tallying; needs judgement stays human.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native forms and fixed response summaries can support needs surveys; they do not obtain answers, establish representative coverage or interpret emergency needs.

assumptions: Director defines all questions/method in s1. Actual respondents produce answers; retained s5 includes field capture, nonresponse follow-up and technical support. No response or coverage flag exists without the actual respondent/team producer.

S2 reduces repeated form construction only. S6 reduces fixed counting/tabulation only while retaining response validation, qualitative reading, coverage/uncertainty judgement and complete final checking. Technical-support-only assignments retain actual support and omit unowned design/distribution branches before reweighting.

Shares are provisional, not measured. Native survey functions first; existing automatic collection/tallies earn zero saving. Actual sends are separate final-version gated actions; save/distribution each retain one percent using existing checking. Any later findings distribution is separately gated with no avoided labour claimed.
unknowns: Which form setup and response tallying remain manual?
research_questions: Can native summaries reduce arithmetic after coverage and complete findings checks?

incremental.description: Maintain actual survey schema and validated response-summary definitions.

approvals.approved_version: s3 exact checked final survey, population and permitted distribution route; edits void approval
s6 checked final actual findings/limitations and exact planning-record destination; edits require recheck

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross 15*0.40 form setup + 19*0.50 fixed tallying = 15.5; minus 1 upkeep = 14.5. Half eligible gives 7.75 minus 1 = 6.75. Survey design, actual conduct/support, interpretation, final checks and sends/save retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Attend emergency-management events to learn and build working relationships.

steps.what: Retrieve and check actual emergency-management event agenda, participant context and relevant source papers
inputs: actual meeting/conference/workshop invitation
actual agenda and relevant emergency-management papers
outputs: checked actual event context

steps.what: Attend actual meetings, conferences and workshops, learn information and develop specialist relationships
inputs: checked actual event context
actual specialist discussion and workshop activities
outputs: actual learned information and working relationships

steps.what: Record and check actual useful learning and agreed follow-up where required
inputs: actual learned information and working relationships
outputs: checked final actual learning/follow-up note

steps.what: Save checked actual event learning/follow-up note
inputs: checked final actual learning/follow-up note
outputs: saved actual learning note

tasks.design: Configure native event-to-agenda/source links in {CALENDAR} and {DOCS}. Retain substantive reading, actual attendance and relationship building, with any actual new learning-note capture/check followed by a separate save.
tasks.previous_blocker: Event preparation can repeat agenda/source navigation.
tasks.enabler_now: Native event/source links can reduce retrieval.
tasks.still_hard: Learning and professional trust require actual participation.
tasks.human_edge: The director develops relationships that matter during an actual emergency.
tasks.altitude: Less event lookup; participation stays human.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native event/source links can support preparation; they do not learn, attend or build working relationships.

assumptions: Actual organisers supply agenda/papers; director checks them in s1 and retains substantive reading. All actual attendance and relationship work remains in s2.

Notes only if actually required, not mandatory event reports; remove unused record branch and reweight. Actual written follow-up, if required, is a separately exact-final-content gated send. No avoided follow-up labour claimed.
Shares are provisional, not measured. Preparation counted once per actual event; existing links earn zero saving. Save retains one percent using existing final checking.
research_questions: Can native links reduce navigation while retaining actual learning and relationships?

approvals.approved_version: s3 checked final actual learning note and exact destination; edits require recheck

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross 10*0.40 lookup = 4; minus 0.5 upkeep = 3.5. Half eligible gives 2 minus 0.5 = 1.5. Reading, participation, new note capture/check and save retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Propose evidence-based changes to emergency response procedures.

steps.what: Retrieve and verify actual regulatory/technology changes, incident outcomes and current response procedures
inputs: actual source changes and incident records
actual approved response-procedure versions
outputs: checked actual change evidence and procedure context

steps.what: Evaluate actual implications and choose proposed emergency response procedure alterations
inputs: checked actual change evidence and procedure context
actual operational dependencies and responder feedback
outputs: actual chosen proposed alterations, rationale and unresolved risks

steps.what: Draft proposed procedure alterations and rationale from director-chosen changes and exact source versions
inputs: actual chosen proposed alterations, rationale and unresolved risks
checked actual change evidence and procedure context
outputs: source-linked proposed procedure redline and rationale draft

loop.purpose: Draft variable redline wording from actual chosen procedure changes
loop.input: exact current procedure and director-chosen alterations/rationale
loop.check: Compare meaning, responsibilities, conditions and dependencies against chosen changes; flag omissions and unsupported regulatory conclusions
loop.stop: Missing version/source or two failed checks requires manual drafting
loop.why_not_simpler: Native version comparison/templates first; variable procedural prose alone needs bounded drafting

steps.what: Check complete final procedure-change proposal, operational consequences and actual review recipients
inputs: source-linked proposed procedure redline and rationale draft
actual chosen proposed alterations, rationale and unresolved risks
outputs: checked final proposed redline/rationale and permitted destinations

steps.what: Save checked final proposed emergency response procedure alterations
inputs: checked final proposed redline/rationale and permitted destinations
outputs: saved actual change proposal

steps.what: Send exact checked procedure-change proposal to actual responsible review owners
inputs: checked final proposed redline/rationale and permitted destinations
outputs: actual change proposal delivered for owner review

tasks.design: Configure native source/version links in {DOCS} and {OPS_SYSTEM}, then use a bounded redline draft only for director-chosen changes. Retain full operational evaluation and final proposal checking before separate save and owner delivery through {EMAIL}.
tasks.previous_blocker: Change proposals repeat source navigation and redline prose.
tasks.enabler_now: Native version links and bounded drafting can reduce those repetitions.
tasks.still_hard: Actual response dependencies and safe procedure changes need operational judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The director recognises a proposed improvement that would fail under real emergency conditions.
tasks.altitude: Less proposal administration; response decisions stay human.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: version-linked redline drafting can assist procedure proposals; it does not interpret new obligations authoritatively or enact response changes.

assumptions: Actual regulation/technology publishers and incident owners produce source changes and measured outcomes; current procedure has its actual owner/version. Director verifies sources in s1, evaluates consequences and chooses all changes in s2.

S3 retains 17.5 provisional hours of chosen-change capture and draft checking; s4 retains full final meaning, dependency and omission review. No alteration takes effect on proposal delivery. Actual owner adoption/publication is a distinct exact-final-procedure gated action, not inferred here.

Shares are provisional, not measured. Native version tools first; existing redlines earn zero saving. Save/send each retain one percent using existing checking. Shared event/outcome evidence counted once.
unknowns: Which source navigation and proposal prose repeat?
research_questions: Can drafting reduce prose after full operational/dependency review?

already_counted.description: Chosen-change capture and draft checking retained in s3.

incremental.description: Maintain actual version/source links and test faithful procedure redlines.

approvals.approved_version: s4 checked final proposal redline/rationale and exact proposal-record destination; edits require recheck
s4 exact final proposal redline/rationale and authorised review recipients; edits void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross 20*0.40 lookup + 25*0.30 prose = 15.5; minus 1 upkeep = 14.5. Half eligible gives 7.75 minus 1 = 6.75. Actual evaluation, choices, complete final review and save/send retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Develop public emergency-plan materials and present them to citizens.

steps.what: Retrieve and check actual approved emergency plans and implementation instructions for intended public audience
inputs: actual approved emergency plan/version
actual audience and public-information requirements
outputs: checked applicable public plan instructions

steps.what: Choose actual public learning objectives, essential instructions and accessible presentation format
inputs: checked applicable public plan instructions
actual audience access/language needs
outputs: chosen actual instructional content and presentation approach

steps.what: Draft actual public instructional materials from approved plans and chosen learning objectives
inputs: chosen actual instructional content and presentation approach
checked applicable public plan instructions
outputs: source-linked actual public instructional draft

loop.purpose: Draft accessible explanations of approved emergency instructions
loop.input: exact approved public instructions and chosen objectives
loop.check: Verify every action, trigger, contact and sequence; check omissions, accessibility and no added response instructions
loop.stop: Missing approved source or two failed checks requires manual writing
loop.why_not_simpler: Native approved sections/templates first; variable audience explanation alone needs bounded drafting

steps.what: Check complete final public materials, correct plan version, accessibility and permitted publication destination
inputs: source-linked actual public instructional draft
checked applicable public plan instructions
outputs: checked final public materials and permitted destinations

steps.what: Save checked final public emergency-plan instructional materials
inputs: checked final public materials and permitted destinations
outputs: saved actual public materials

steps.what: Publish or distribute exact checked instructional materials through actual authorised public channel
inputs: checked final public materials and permitted destinations
outputs: actual public materials distributed

steps.what: Make actual presentations to citizens' groups and explain emergency-plan implementation and answer questions
inputs: checked final public materials and permitted destinations
actual citizens' questions and understanding
outputs: actual presentation and public questions addressed

tasks.design: Configure approved-plan links in {OPS_SYSTEM} and {DOCS}, then use templates and bounded audience-language drafting for public materials. The director chooses instructions, checks the complete final version before separate save/distribution in {CMS}, and retains actual citizen presentations.
tasks.previous_blocker: Public materials repeat source navigation and explanations of chosen plan instructions.
tasks.enabler_now: Native source links and bounded faithful drafting can reduce preparation.
tasks.still_hard: Clear public action and real audience understanding need competent explanation.
tasks.human_edge: The director responds when citizens misunderstand an instruction or face a practical implementation barrier.
tasks.altitude: Less material preparation; public presentation stays human.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: approved-source links and bounded accessible drafting can assist instructional preparation; they do not establish emergency actions or replace citizen presentations.

assumptions: Actual plan owners supply current approved public instructions. Director verifies scope and chooses learning objectives in s1/s2. No draft creates new emergency response policy or live emergency alert.

S3 retains 12 provisional hours of new audience-content capture and draft checking; s4 retains complete instruction/omission/accessibility review. Actual citizen interaction remains in s7. Preparation counted once per new/revised material, not per attendee.

Shares are provisional, not measured. Native templates first; existing approved materials earn zero saving. Separate distribution applies only if actual; otherwise omit and reweight. Save/distribution each retain one percent using existing checking. Any actual post-presentation note/send needs its own final-content gated record/action, no avoided labour assumed.
unknowns: Which materials are actually newly prepared rather than reused?
research_questions: Can drafting reduce preparation after full action-sequence and accessibility checks?

already_counted.description: Audience-content capture and draft checking retained in s3.

incremental.description: Maintain actual public-plan sources and test faithful accessible drafting.

approvals.approved_version: s4 checked final public materials and exact draft destination; edits require recheck
s4 exact final public materials and authorised public channel/audience; edits void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross 15*0.40 retrieval + 20*0.40 drafting = 14; minus 1 upkeep = 13. Half eligible gives 7 minus 1 = 6. Actual instructional choices, complete checking, save/distribution and presentations retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Emergency directors retain needs, response and public-action judgement while actual survey arithmetic and document preparation may shrink.
role.ambitious_version: Measure actual repeated preparation while retaining field knowledge, professional relationships and accountable response decisions.
